      PERFORM make_income_list1.
      PERFORM make_income_list2.
      PERFORM fill_itab_dme_hon.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    IF objectr = 'X' AND lsp_form = 'X'.                    "N1559867
      IF ee_type = 'LSP'.
        PERFORM make_income_list1.
        PERFORM make_income_list2.
        PERFORM fill_itab_dme.
      ENDIF.
*    ELSEIF OBJECTH  = 'X'.                             "N1559867
    ELSEIF objectr = 'X' AND hon_form = 'X'.                "N1559867
      IF ee_type  = 'HON'.
        PERFORM make_income_list1.
        PERFORM make_income_list2.
        PERFORM fill_itab_dme_hon.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* QU796286
*    IF objectr = 'X'.
*      PERFORM make_income_list1.
*      PERFORM make_income_list2.
*      PERFORM fill_itab_dme.
ENDFORM. " FILL_DME

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2010
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1536031
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_2010 USING file_type. "N1559867
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_10 USING 'A' file_type.     "N1559867

  SORT b_record     BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_hon BY bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record     BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_10 USING 'B' file_type.   "N1559867
    LOOP AT c_record_hon WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                           AND stcd2   = b_record-stcd2
                           AND bukrs   = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_10 USING 'C' file_type. "N1559867
      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_hon-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_10 USING 'D' file_type. "N1559867
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2010

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_10
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1536031
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->RECORDNAME   NAME OF RECORD (A/B/C/D)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record_10 USING recordname
                                      file_type.            "N1559867
  IF file_type = 'LSP'.
    CLEAR datafile_10. REFRESH datafile_10.

    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM  add_arecord_to_datafile_10.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM  add_brecord_to_datafile_10.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM  add_crecord_to_datafile_10.
      WHEN 'D'.
        PERFORM  add_drecord_to_datafile_10.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = datafile_10.
  ELSEIF file_type = 'TDF'.
    CLEAR datafile_tdf. REFRESH datafile_tdf.

    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM  add_arecord_to_datafile_tdf.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM  add_brecord_to_datafile_tdf.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM  add_crecord_to_datafile_tdf.
      WHEN 'D'.
        PERFORM  add_drecord_to_datafile_tdf.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = datafile_tdf.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_10

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_10
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1536031
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_arecord_to_datafile_10 .
  MOVE: a_record-r_modif        TO datafile_10+0(1),
        a_record-d_modif_hon    TO datafile_10+1(2),
        a_record-tax_off        TO datafile_10+3(3),
        a_record-submitdt       TO datafile_10+6(8),
        a_record-agency         TO datafile_10+14(1),
        a_record-agent_num      TO datafile_10+15(6),
        a_record-home_tax_id    TO datafile_10+21(20),
        a_record-item8_space    TO datafile_10+41(4),
        a_record-stcd2          TO datafile_10+45(10),
        a_record-comnm          TO datafile_10+55(40),
        a_record-sub_dept       TO datafile_10+95(30),
        a_record-sub_name       TO datafile_10+125(30),
        a_record-ag_telnr       TO datafile_10+155(15),
        a_record-b_rec_num      TO datafile_10+170(5),
        a_record-hangle_code    TO datafile_10+175(3),
        space                   TO datafile_10+178(802).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+0(41)  41.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+41(54) 54.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+95(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+125(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+155(825) 825.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_10. REFRESH datafile_10.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_10.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_10.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_10

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ADD_BRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_10
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1536031
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_brecord_to_datafile_10 .
  MOVE :  b_record-r_modif         TO  datafile_10+0(1),
          b_record-d_modif_hon     TO  datafile_10+1(2),
          b_record-tax_off         TO  datafile_10+3(3).
  UNPACK: b_record-seqno           TO  datafile_10+6(6).
  MOVE :  b_record-stcd2           TO  datafile_10+12(10),
          b_record-comnm           TO  datafile_10+22(40),
          b_record-repres          TO  datafile_10+62(30),
          b_record-stcd1           TO  datafile_10+92(13).
  UNPACK: b_record-c_rec_num       TO  datafile_10+105(7),
          b_record-d_rec_num       TO  datafile_10+112(7),
          b_record-tot_separ       TO  datafile_10+119(14),
          b_record-inc_tax         TO  datafile_10+133(13),
          b_record-legal_tax       TO  datafile_10+146(13),
          b_record-det_rtax        TO  datafile_10+159(13),
          b_record-det_stax        TO  datafile_10+172(13),
          b_record-det_total       TO  datafile_10+185(13),
          b_record-submit_period   TO  datafile_10+198(1).
  MOVE:   space                    TO  datafile_10+199(781).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+0(62)  62.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+62(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+92(888) 888.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_10. REFRESH datafile_10.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_10.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_10.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " ADD_BRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_10

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ADD_CRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_10
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1536031
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_crecord_to_datafile_10 .
  MOVE: c_record_hon-r_modif               TO  datafile_10+0(1),

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+0(72)  72.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+72(51)  51.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_10+123(857) 857.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_10. REFRESH datafile_10.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_10.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_10.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " ADD_CRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_10

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  READ_RGDIR_WITH_DATE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1561401
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_rgdir_with_date TABLES p_rgdir
                          USING p_date.

  DATA: tem_rgdir LIKE rgdir OCCURS 0.

  CALL FUNCTION 'CU_READ_RGDIR'
    EXPORTING
      persnr          = pernr-pernr
    TABLES
      in_rgdir        = tem_rgdir
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_record_found = 1
      OTHERS          = 2.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    PERFORM error_handling USING pernr-pernr '405'
                                 space space space space.

    REJECT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'CD_READ_DATE_RANGE_ACTUAL_NV'
    EXPORTING
      begda     = p_date
      endda     = p_date
    TABLES
      rgdir_in  = tem_rgdir
      rgdir_out = p_rgdir.
ENDFORM. "READ_RGDIR_WITH_DATE

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  MODIFY_SCREEN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1559867
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM modify_screen .
*<<<N1473213 - add MODIF ID for hiding Honorable form and DME
  DATA: ind TYPE c VALUE 0.

*<<< N2154711
  CASE proc_typ.
    WHEN 1.
      CLEAR: ee_addr.
      WRITE icon_checked AS ICON TO korean+0(4).
      MOVE space TO english+0(4).
    WHEN 2.
      WRITE icon_checked AS ICON TO english+0(4).
      MOVE SPACE TO KOREAN+0(4).
  ENDCASE.
*>>> N2154711

  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'HON'.
      IF end_dt(4) >= 2010.
        hon_form = ' '.
        screen-invisible = '1'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF screen-group1 = 'COP'.
      IF end_dt(4) >= 2011 .
        IF lsp_form <> 'X' AND tdf_form <> 'X' .
          ind = 1.
        ENDIF.
      ELSEIF end_dt(4) < 2010 OR lsp_form <> 'X' .
        ind = 1.
      ENDIF.
      IF ind = 1.
        p_kbee = 'X'. p_kber = p_rber = ' '.
        p_kbee = 'X'. p_kber = p_rber = ' '.
        screen-input = '0'.
      ELSE.
        screen-input = '1'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF screen-group1 = 'ESP'.
      IF end_dt(4) <> 2010.
        esp_form = ' '.
        screen-invisible = '1'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF screen-group1 = 'LSP'.
      IF end_dt(4) > 2012.
        screen-input = '0'.
        screen-invisible = '1'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    IF proc_typ = 1 AND screen-group1 EQ 'ENG'.
      screen-input = '0'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
    ENDIF.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.
*>>>N1473213
  IF end_dt(4) >=  2013.                            "N1800801
    lsp_form = 'X'. hon_form = ' '.
    tdf_form = ' '. esp_form = ' '.
  ENDIF.
*<<< N1559867 Disable Data Medium Creation
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'DME' OR screen-group1 = 'SBP' OR
       screen-group1 = 'SUB'.
      IF esp_form = 'X'.
        object = 'X'.
        objectr = ' '.
        screen-input = '0'.
      ELSE.
        screen-input = '1'.
      ENDIF.
*>>>N1800801- hide Tax deferring DME from 2012
      IF TDF_FORM = 'X' AND end_dt(4) >= 2012 AND
        ( screen-group1 = 'DME' OR screen-group1 = 'SUB' OR
          screen-group1 = 'SBP' ).
        screen-input = '0'.
      ENDIF.
*<<<N1800801
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
*>>> N1559867
*>>>N1713857 hide tax deferring form from 2013.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'TDF' AND end_dt(4) > 2012.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
      tdf_form = ' '.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
*<<<N1713857

*<<< N2177581 Migration of Korean Forms to PDF
  PERFORM get_pdf_form_flag USING end_dt(4) CHANGING gv_pdf_flag.
  IF gv_pdf_flag IS NOT INITIAL.
    PERFORM set_print_form_type USING 'SWF' 'SWG'.
  ELSE.
  CALL METHOD cl_hr99b_form=>switch_fields_off            "ACC >>>
    EXPORTING
      p_if_is_active = abap_true
      p_molga        = hr99b_form_sel-molga
      p_appl         = c_appl-sepr
      p_modif_id     = 'SWF'.
  CALL METHOD cl_hr99b_form=>switch_fields_off
    EXPORTING
      p_if_is_active = abap_false
      p_molga        = hr99b_form_sel-molga
      p_appl         = c_appl-sepr
      p_modif_id     = 'SWG'.                             "ACC <<<
  ENDIF.
*>>> N2177581
ENDFORM. " MODIFY_SCREEN

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  SET_FORM_NAME
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_form_name .
  DATA: tem_end_dt TYPE d,
        tem_form   TYPE rsscf-tdform.

  IF lsp_form = 'X'.
    CHECK form(9) = 'HR_KR_SEP' OR form IS INITIAL.       "N2298108
    form(10) = 'HR_KR_SEPR'.
*<<< N1850073, N1850074 Terry Begin

    tem_form = form.
    tem_end_dt+0(4) = end_dt+0(4) - 1.
    tem_end_dt+4(4) = end_dt+4(4).
    PERFORM re596f USING 'HRKRSEPR' tem_end_dt
                   CHANGING tem_form+10(2).
    IF tem_form NE form.
      PERFORM re596f USING 'HRKRSEPR' end_dt              "NAN0507759
                     CHANGING form+10(2).
    ENDIF.
*<<< N1850073, N1850074 Terry End
  ELSEIF hon_form = 'X'.
    CHECK form(9) = 'HR_KR_SEP'.                          "JINQUE1378757
    form(10) = 'HR_KR_SEPH'.
    PERFORM re596f USING 'HRKRSEPH' end_dt                "NAN0507759
                   CHANGING form+10(2).
    IF form+10(2) IS INITIAL.
      PERFORM error_handling2 USING 'HRPADKR01' 'E' '407'
                                    space space space space.
      REJECT.
    ENDIF.
*<<<N1379685 - Sep. Tax Deferring:
  ELSEIF tdf_form = 'X'.
    CHECK form(9) = 'HR_KR_SEP'.
    form(10) = 'HR_KR_SEPD'.
    PERFORM re596f USING 'HRKRSEPD' end_dt
                   CHANGING form+10(2).
*>>>N1379685
*<<<N1473213 - Statement of estimated retirement income witholding tax
  ELSEIF esp_form = 'X'.
    CHECK form(9) = 'HR_KR_SEP'.
    form(10) = 'HR_KR_SEPE'.
    PERFORM re596f USING 'HRKRSEPE' end_dt
                   CHANGING form+10(2).
*>>>N1473213
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " SET_FORM_NAME

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_TDF
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1559867
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_arecord_to_datafile_tdf.
  MOVE:   a_record-r_modif      TO datafile_tdf+0(1),
          a_record-tax_off      TO datafile_tdf+1(3),
          a_record-submitdt     TO datafile_tdf+4(8),
          a_record-stcd2        TO datafile_tdf+12(10),
          a_record-comnm        TO datafile_tdf+22(40),
          a_record-sub_dept     TO datafile_tdf+62(30),
          a_record-sub_name     TO datafile_tdf+92(30),
          a_record-ag_telnr     TO datafile_tdf+122(15).
  UNPACK: a_record-b_rec_num    TO datafile_tdf+137(10),
          a_record-c_rec_num    TO datafile_tdf+147(10),
          a_record-d_rec_num    TO datafile_tdf+157(10).
  MOVE:   space                 TO datafile_tdf+167(256).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_tdf+0(62)  62.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2011
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FILE_TYPE  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_2011 USING file_type.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_11 USING 'A' file_type.

  SORT b_record     BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_hon BY bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record     BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_11 USING 'B' file_type.
    LOOP AT c_record_hon WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                           AND stcd2   = b_record-stcd2
                           AND bukrs   = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_11 USING 'C' file_type.
      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_hon-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_11 USING 'D' file_type.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2011
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_11
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_8915   text
*      -->P_FILE_TYPE  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record_11 USING recordname
                                        file_type.
  IF file_type = 'LSP'.
    CLEAR datafile_11. REFRESH datafile_11.

    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM  add_arecord_to_datafile_11.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM  add_brecord_to_datafile_11.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM  add_crecord_to_datafile_11.
      WHEN 'D'.
        PERFORM  add_drecord_to_datafile_11.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = datafile_11.
  ELSEIF file_type = 'TDF'.
    CLEAR datafile_tdf_11. REFRESH datafile_tdf_11.

    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM  add_arecord_to_datafile_tdf_11.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM  add_brecord_to_datafile_tdf_11.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM  add_crecord_to_datafile_tdf_11.
      WHEN 'D'.
        PERFORM  add_drecord_to_datafile_tdf_11.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = datafile_tdf_11.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_11

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CHECK_SAME_YEAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log]  Create: N1688394
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_same_year USING p_paydt TYPE d
                            p_krsp1 LIKE krsp1
                      CHANGING p_same_year.
  DATA: p_chkdt       TYPE d,
        p_tax_year(4) TYPE c.

  READ TABLE p0538 WITH KEY begda = p_paydt adjst = '1'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    p_chkdt = p0538-ospdt.
  ELSE.
    p_chkdt = p_paydt.
  ENDIF.

  IF occat = pkr99_occ_mid_sep.
    IF NOT p_krsp1-agpdt IS INITIAL.
      p_tax_year = p_krsp1-agpdt(4).
    ELSE.
      p_tax_year = p_paydt(4).
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    p_tax_year = p_krsp1-sepdt(4).
  ENDIF.

  SORT p0538 BY endda DESCENDING.
  LOOP AT p0538 WHERE begda < p_chkdt AND adjst = ' '.
*   The last one is mid-separation, check pay date or agreed pay date
    IF NOT p0538-agpdt IS INITIAL AND p0538-agpdt(4) = p_tax_year.
      p_same_year = 'X'.
    ELSEIF p0538-begda(4) = p_tax_year.
      p_same_year = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " CHECK_SAME_YEAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2012
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N1800801 [CREATE] - 2012 separation DME
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->FILE_TYPE  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2012 using file_type.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_12 USING 'A' file_type.

  SORT b_record     BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_hon BY bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record     BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_12 USING 'B' file_type.
    LOOP AT c_record_hon WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                           AND stcd2   = b_record-stcd2
                           AND bukrs   = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_12 USING 'C' file_type.
      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_hon-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_12 USING 'D' file_type.
      ENDLOOP.
      LOOP AT e_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_hon-pernr.   "N1800801
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_12 USING 'E' file_type.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
endform. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2012
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_12
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N1800801-[CREATE]
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->recordname   text
*      -->file_type  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_12 using recordname
                                        file_type.
  IF file_type = 'LSP'.
    CLEAR datafile_12. REFRESH datafile_12.

    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM  add_arecord_to_datafile_12.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM  add_brecord_to_datafile_12.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM  add_crecord_to_datafile_12.
      WHEN 'D'.
        PERFORM  add_drecord_to_datafile_12.
      WHEN 'E'.
        PERFORM  add_erecord_to_datafile_12.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = datafile_12.
  ENDIF.
endform. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_12

        "<<< Same variants with Hon payment
        c_record_hon-spamt_hon             TO  datafile_12+663(10),
        c_record_hon-spded_hon             TO  datafile_12+673(10),
        c_record_hon-sptxl_hon             TO  datafile_12+683(10),
        c_record_hon-avtxl_hon             TO  datafile_12+693(10),
        c_record_hon-avtax_hon             TO  datafile_12+703(10),
        ">>>
*       Lsp payment
        c_record_hon-sep_amt               TO  datafile_12+713(10),
        c_record_hon-sep_deduct            TO  datafile_12+723(10),
        c_record_hon-taxbase               TO  datafile_12+733(10),
        c_record_hon-taxb_year             TO  datafile_12+743(10),
        c_record_hon-tax_year              TO  datafile_12+753(10),
        c_record_hon-ctax                  TO  datafile_12+763(10),
        c_record_hon-lsp_taxcredit_oversea TO  datafile_12+773(10),
*       Hon payment
        c_record_hon-hon_amt               TO  datafile_12+783(10),
        c_record_hon-hon_deduct            TO  datafile_12+793(10),
        c_record_hon-hon_taxbase           TO  datafile_12+803(10),
        c_record_hon-hon_taxb_year         TO  datafile_12+813(10),
        c_record_hon-hon_tax_year          TO  datafile_12+823(10),
        c_record_hon-hon_ctax              TO  datafile_12+833(10),
        c_record_hon-hon_taxcredit_oversea TO  datafile_12+843(10),
*       LSP + HON
        c_record_hon-tot_amt               TO  datafile_12+853(10),
        c_record_hon-tot_deduct            TO  datafile_12+863(10),
        c_record_hon-tot_taxbase           TO  datafile_12+873(10),
        c_record_hon-tot_taxb_year         TO  datafile_12+883(10),
        c_record_hon-tot_tax_year          TO  datafile_12+893(10),
        c_record_hon-tot_ctax              TO  datafile_12+903(10),
        c_record_hon-tot_taxcredit_oversea TO  datafile_12+913(10),
*       Determined tax
        c_record_hon-det_itax              TO  datafile_12+923(10),
        c_record_hon-det_rtax              TO  datafile_12+933(10),
        c_record_hon-det_stax              TO  datafile_12+943(10),
        c_record_hon-det_total1            TO  datafile_12+953(10),
*       Pre-paid tax
        c_record_hon-pre_itax              TO  datafile_12+963(10),
        c_record_hon-pre_rtax              TO  datafile_12+973(10),
        c_record_hon-pre_stax              TO  datafile_12+983(10),
        c_record_hon-pre_total1            TO  datafile_12+993(10),
        space                              TO  datafile_12+1003(7).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_12+0(72)  72.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_12+72(51)  51.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_12+123(887) 887.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_12. REFRESH datafile_12.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_12.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_12.
  ENDIF.
endform. " ADD_CRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_12
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ADD_DRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_12

form ADD_DRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_12 .
  DATA: l_stotal(10) TYPE n,
        l_htotal(10) TYPE n.
  CLEAR: l_stotal, l_htotal.

  l_stotal = d_record-spy02 + d_record-srp02.
  l_htotal = d_record-hpy02 + d_record-hrp02.

  MOVE: d_record-r_modif       TO  datafile_12+0(1),
        d_record-d_modif_hon   TO  datafile_12+1(2),
        d_record-tax_off       TO  datafile_12+3(3),
        d_record-seqno         TO  datafile_12+6(6),
        d_record-stcd2         TO  datafile_12+12(10),
        d_record-pre_space     TO  datafile_12+22(50),
        d_record-regno         TO  datafile_12+72(13),
        d_record-com02         TO  datafile_12+85(40),
        d_record-bus02         TO  datafile_12+125(10),
        d_record-spy02         TO  datafile_12+135(10),
        d_record-hpy02         TO  datafile_12+145(10),
        d_record-srp02         TO  datafile_12+155(10),
        d_record-hrp02         TO  datafile_12+165(10),
*<<< Split total for legal and non-legal
        l_stotal               TO  datafile_12+175(10),
        l_htotal               TO  datafile_12+185(10),
*>>> Split total for legal and non-legal
        d_record-nontax_inc    TO  datafile_12+195(10),
        d_record-d_seqno       TO  datafile_12+205(2),
        space                  TO  datafile_12+207(803).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_12+0(125)  125.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_12+125(885) 885.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* COMVERT HEX STREAM TO UNICODE STRING
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_12. REFRESH datafile_12.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_12.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_12.
  ENDIF.
endform. " ADD_DRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_12

    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILL_E_RECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N1800801-[CREATE]
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form FILL_E_RECORD .
  CLEAR e_record.
  CHECK itab_c-adjst = 'X'.                                   "N1814910
  MOVE pernr-pernr            TO e_record-pernr.
  MOVE c_record_hon-bukrs     TO e_record-bukrs.
  MOVE : 'E'                  TO e_record-r_modif,
         '25'                 TO e_record-d_modif,
         c_record_hon-tax_off TO e_record-tax_off,
         c_record_hon-seqno   TO e_record-seqno,
         c_record_hon-stcd2   TO e_record-stcd2,
         space                TO e_record-espace,
         c_record_hon-regno   TO e_record-regno.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING itab_c   TO e_record.
  MOVE 1                      TO e_record-e_seqno.
  APPEND e_record.
endform. " FILL_E_RECORD
*<<< N1831602 Terry Begin
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILL_SP_2013
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form FILL_SP_2013 .
  DATA: amount          LIKE rt-betrg,
        total           LIKE rt-betrg,
        tmp_ttl         LIKE rt-betrg,
        separ_cur       LIKE rt-betrg,
        separ_pre1      LIKE rt-betrg,
        separ_dep_cur   LIKE rt-betrg,
        l_taxble_base   LIKE rt-betrg,
        l_tot_bas_ded   LIKE rt-betrg,
        l_sep_ped_ded   LIKE rt-betrg,
        lv_ret_tax_base LIKE rt-betrg,                  "N2251634
        lv_retax_amt    LIKE rt-betrg.                  "N1964819

*-------------------------------------------------------------------
* Sepration payment(Current work place)
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wtr_tot_separation CHANGING amount.
  separ_cur = amount.
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING PKR99_WTR_TOT_SEPARATION_HON
                        CHANGING amount.
  separ_cur = separ_cur + amount.
* Deposit legal part (Current work place)
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wt_deposit_lsp CHANGING amount.
  separ_dep_cur = separ_dep_cur + amount.
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wt_deposit_hon CHANGING amount.
  separ_dep_cur = separ_dep_cur + amount.
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wt_deposit_lsp_pre CHANGING amount.
  separ_dep_cur = separ_dep_cur + amount.
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wt_deposit_hon_pre CHANGING amount.
  separ_dep_cur = separ_dep_cur + amount.
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wt_deposit_rep CHANGING amount.
  separ_dep_cur = separ_dep_cur + amount.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Payment infomation from 1st ex-company
  MOVE  krsp1-bus01  TO itab_c-bus01.
  PERFORM re7krp1 USING itab_c-bus01.
  MOVE t7krp1-comnm  TO itab_c-pre_comnm.
* Separation payment from 1st previous company
  separ_pre1 = krsp1-spy01 + krsp1-ipy01 + krsp1-spy02 + krsp1-ipy02
             + krsp1-hpy01 + krsp1-hpy02.
  separ_cur = separ_cur - separ_pre1.

*LQ N1935023 Start
  READ TABLE p0538 WITH KEY begda = rgdir-bondt adjst = '1'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND p0538-rfitx IS NOT INITIAL.
    PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wtr_det_inc_tax_ori
                          CHANGING amount.
    lv_retax_amt = separ_cur + amount.                                "N1964819
    READ TABLE rt WITH KEY lgart = pkr99_wtr_det_res_tax_ori.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      PERFORM re511k_without_dump USING '41' 'JUMIN' rgdir-bondt.
      amount = amount * t511k-kwert / 100.
      trunc amount 1.
      lv_retax_amt = lv_retax_amt + amount.                           "N1964819
    ELSE.
      lv_retax_amt = lv_retax_amt + rt-betrg.                         "N1964819
    ENDIF.
    change_curr lv_retax_amt itab_c-sep_pay_defer.                    "N1964819
  ENDIF.
*LQ N1935023 End
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Set Adjust Indicator for printing tax convert session
  IF separ_dep_cur > 0.
    itab_c-adjst = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_ser_ped_ded    itab_c-sep_ped_ded.
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_tot_bas_ded    itab_c-tot_bas_ded.
* Sum to totals and put to itab_c.
  change_curr: separ_cur      itab_c-spy00,
               separ_pre1     itab_c-spy01,
               separ_dep_cur  itab_c-depcu_sep.

  tmp_ttl = separ_cur + separ_pre1.
  total   = total + tmp_ttl.
  change_curr  tmp_ttl        itab_c-sptot.

  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wtr_ser_ped_ded
                        CHANGING l_sep_ped_ded.
  PERFORM read_rt_betrg USING pkr99_wtr_tot_bas_ded
                        CHANGING l_tot_bas_ded.
  l_taxble_base = total - l_tot_bas_ded - l_sep_ped_ded.
  itab_c-taxble_base_13 =  l_taxble_base.               "N1978663
  change_curr  l_taxble_base itab_c-taxble_base.

  tmp_ttl = separ_dep_cur.
  change_curr  tmp_ttl        itab_c-deptt.

  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_ser_ped_ded    itab_c-sep_ped_ded.
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_tot_bas_ded    itab_c-tot_bas_ded.
*>>> N2251634
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_sep_ser_ded    itab_c-sep_ser_ded.    "/R59
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_conv_pay_amt   itab_c-conv_pay_amt.   "/R60
  lv_ret_tax_base = amount.
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_conv_grad_ded  itab_c-conv_grad_ded.  "/R67
  lv_ret_tax_base = lv_ret_tax_base - amount.
  change_curr lv_ret_tax_base itab_c-ret_tax_base.
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_conv_inc_tax   itab_c-conv_inc_tax.   "/R68
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_sep_cal_tax    itab_c-sep_cal_tax.    "/R69
  put_wage_type   pkr99_wtr_rsta_cal_tax   itab_c-rsta_cal_tax.   "/R70
*<<< N2251634
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fill in IRA deposit information
  CLEAR gv_drecord_flag.                                    "N2108719
*<<< N2114673 Two entries for IRP information
  IF start_dt(4) >= '2015' OR
   ( start_dt(4) = '2014' AND form+10(2) = '14' ).
*<<< N2151233 Separation and Tax-deferring on same day
    LOOP AT p0538 WHERE begda = rgdir-bondt
                  AND ( adjst = '1' OR ( adjst = '' AND payrp = 'O' ) ).
*>>> N2151233
      itab_c-ira_nam01 = p0538-iranm.
      itab_c-ira_biz01 = p0538-irabn.
      itab_c-dep_acc01 = p0538-depac.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-ira_biz01 WITH ''.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-dep_acc01 WITH ''.   "N2150719

      itab_c-dep_dat01 = p0538-depdt.
      IF p0538-depdt IS INITIAL.
        itab_c-dep_dat01 = p0538-begda.
      ENDIF.

      change_curr: p0538-depam itab_c-dep_amt01.
      IF p0538-depam IS INITIAL.
        itab_c-dep_amt01 = itab_c-deptt.
      ENDIF.
*<<< N2135092
      itab_c-ira_name     = itab_c-ira_nam01.
      itab_c-ira_biz_no   = itab_c-ira_biz01.
      itab_c-deposit_acc  = itab_c-dep_acc01.
      itab_c-deposit_date = itab_c-dep_dat01.
*>>> N2135092
*<<< N2150719
      itab_c-ira_nam02 = p0538-irm01.
      itab_c-ira_biz02 = p0538-irn01.
      itab_c-dep_acc02 = p0538-dec01.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-ira_biz02 WITH ''.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-dep_acc02 WITH ''.
      itab_c-dep_dat02 = p0538-det01.
      IF p0538-dem01 IS NOT INITIAL AND p0538-det01 IS INITIAL.
        itab_c-dep_dat02 = p0538-begda.
      ENDIF.
      IF p0538-dem01 IS NOT INITIAL.
        change_curr: p0538-dem01 itab_c-dep_amt02.
      ENDIF.
*>>> N2150719
      gv_drecord_flag = 'X'.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
*>>> N2114673
    READ TABLE p0538 WITH KEY begda = rgdir-bondt adjst = '1'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      itab_c-ira_name     = p0538-iranm.
      itab_c-ira_biz_no   = p0538-irabn.
      itab_c-deposit_acc  = p0538-depac.
*<<<N1559867: remove possible '-' in account.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-ira_biz_no WITH ''.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-deposit_acc WITH ''.
*>>>N1559867
     itab_c-deposit_date = p0538-depdt.
     gv_drecord_flag = 'X'.                                   "N2108719
   ENDIF.
*<<< N1880822, N1852120 Terry Begin
    READ TABLE p0538 WITH KEY begda = rgdir-bondt adjst = ''.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND p0538-payrp = 'O'.
      itab_c-ira_name     = p0538-iranm.
      itab_c-ira_biz_no   = p0538-irabn.
      itab_c-deposit_acc  = p0538-depac.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-ira_biz_no WITH ''.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN itab_c-deposit_acc WITH ''.
*      itab_c-deposit_date = p0538-begda.   "comment out by LOU N1916459
*<<<N1916459 by LOU BEGIN
      IF NOT p0538-depdt IS INITIAL.
        itab_c-deposit_date = p0538-depdt.
      ELSE.
        itab_c-deposit_date = p0538-begda.
      ENDIF.
*>>>N1916459 END
      gv_drecord_flag = 'X'.                                  "N2108719
    ENDIF.
*>>> N1880822, N1852120 Terry End
  ENDIF.
endform. " FILL_SP_2013
*>>> N1831602 Terry End

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2013
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N1935023 [CREATE] - 2013 separation DME
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->FILE_TYPE  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2013 using file_type.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_13 USING 'A' file_type.

  SORT b_record     BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_hon BY bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_13 USING 'B' file_type.
    LOOP AT c_record_hon WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                           AND stcd2   = b_record-stcd2
                           AND bukrs   = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_13 USING 'C' file_type.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
endform. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2013
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_13
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N1935023-[CREATE]
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->recordname   text
*      -->file_type  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_13 using recordname
                                        file_type.
  IF file_type = 'LSP'.
    CLEAR datafile_13. REFRESH datafile_13.

    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM  add_arecord_to_datafile_13.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM  add_brecord_to_datafile_13.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM  add_crecord_to_datafile_13.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = datafile_13.
  ENDIF.
endform. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD_13
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_13
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N1935023-[CREATE]
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_13.
  MOVE: a_record-r_modif        TO datafile_13+0(1),
        a_record-d_modif_hon    TO datafile_13+1(2),
        a_record-tax_off        TO datafile_13+3(3),
        a_record-submitdt       TO datafile_13+6(8),
        a_record-agency         TO datafile_13+14(1),
        a_record-agent_num      TO datafile_13+15(6),
        a_record-home_tax_id    TO datafile_13+21(20),
        a_record-item8_space    TO datafile_13+41(4),
        a_record-stcd2          TO datafile_13+45(10),
        a_record-comnm          TO datafile_13+55(40),
        a_record-sub_dept       TO datafile_13+95(30),
        a_record-sub_name       TO datafile_13+125(30),
        a_record-ag_telnr       TO datafile_13+155(15),
        a_record-b_rec_num      TO datafile_13+170(5),
        a_record-hangle_code    TO datafile_13+175(3),
        space                   TO datafile_13+178(1222).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+0(41)  41.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+41(54) 54.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+95(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+125(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+155(1245) 1245.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_13. REFRESH datafile_13.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_13.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_13.
  ENDIF.
endform. " ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_13
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form ADD_BRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_13.
  DATA:
    lv_zero(14) TYPE n.

  MOVE :  b_record-r_modif         TO  datafile_13+0(1),
          b_record-d_modif_hon     TO  datafile_13+1(2),
          b_record-tax_off         TO  datafile_13+3(3).
  UNPACK: b_record-seqno           TO  datafile_13+6(6).
  MOVE :  b_record-stcd2           TO  datafile_13+12(10),
          b_record-comnm           TO  datafile_13+22(40),
          b_record-repres          TO  datafile_13+62(30),
          b_record-stcd1           TO  datafile_13+92(13),
          b_record-taxpayer        TO  datafile_13+105(1).
  UNPACK  b_record-c_rec_num       TO  datafile_13+106(7).
  MOVE    space                    TO  datafile_13+113(7).
  UNPACK  b_record-tot_separ       TO  datafile_13+120(14).
  IF b_record-inc_tax_13 >= 0.                                 "N1983237
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+134(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+134(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-inc_tax_13 to datafile_13+135(13).           "N1983237
  UNPACK b_record-tot_tax_def     TO datafile_13+148(13).

  IF b_record-tot_ref_itax >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+161(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+161(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-tot_ref_itax    TO  datafile_13+162(13).

  IF b_record-tot_ref_rtax >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+175(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+175(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-tot_ref_rtax    TO  datafile_13+176(13).

  MOVE lv_zero                     TO datafile_13+189(14).

  IF b_record-tot_ref_total >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+203(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+203(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-tot_ref_total   TO  datafile_13+204(13).

  MOVE   space                    TO  datafile_13+217(1183).

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+0(62)  62.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+62(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+92(1308) 1308.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_13. REFRESH datafile_13.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_13.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_13.
  ENDIF.
endform. " ADD_BRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_13

  UNPACK c_record_hon-det_rtax_13   TO  datafile_13+1023(11). "Local Income Tax N1983237

  IF c_record_hon-det_stax_13 >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+1034(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+1034(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK c_record_hon-det_stax_13  TO  datafile_13+1035(11). "Special tax

  IF c_record_hon-det_total_13 >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+1046(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+1046(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK c_record_hon-det_total_13 TO  datafile_13+1047(11). "Total N1983237

*Separation Tax- Deffered tax
  MOVE: c_record_hon-defer_tax   TO  datafile_13+1058(11), "Income tax
        c_record_hon-defer_rtax  TO  datafile_13+1069(11), "Local Income Tax
        lv_zero11                TO  datafile_13+1080(11), "Special tax
        c_record_hon-defer_total TO  datafile_13+1091(11). "Total
*Separation Tax- collect/refund tax
  IF c_record_hon-ref_itax_13 >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+1102(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+1102(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK c_record_hon-ref_itax_13 TO datafile_13+1103(11). "Income tax  "N1983237

  IF c_record_hon-ref_rtax_13 >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+1114(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+1114(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK c_record_hon-ref_rtax_13 TO  datafile_13+1115(11). "Local Income Tax N1983237
  MOVE '0'                      TO  datafile_13+1126(1).  "Special tax
  MOVE lv_zero11                TO  datafile_13+1127(11). "Special tax

  IF c_record_hon-ref_total_13 >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to datafile_13+1138(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to datafile_13+1138(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK c_record_hon-ref_total_13   TO  datafile_13+1139(11).  "Total

  MOVE space                    TO  datafile_13+1150(250). "Space

* Unicode
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+0(57)  57.       "N1973561
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+57(90)  90.      "N1973561
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+147(83)  83.     "N1973561
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+230(709) 709.    "N1973561
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile_13+939(461) 461.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

* Convert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile_13. REFRESH datafile_13.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile_13.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile_13.
  ENDIF.
endform. " ADD_CRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_13

form fill_d_record_14.
  DATA: count         TYPE i,
        d_flag        TYPE c.

  count = 1.
  CLEAR: d_flag, d_record_14.

  d_record_14-pernr     = c_record_hon-pernr.
  d_record_14-bukrs     = c_record_hon-bukrs.
  d_record_14-r_modif   = 'D'.
  d_record_14-d_modif   = '25'.
* Tax office
  d_record_14-tax_off   = c_record_hon-tax_off.
* Serial number
  d_record_14-seqno     = c_record_hon-seqno.
* Business number
  d_record_14-stcd2     = c_record_hon-stcd2.
  d_record_14-pre_space = space.
* Resident number
  d_record_14-regno     = c_record_hon-regno.
* Sequence number
  d_record_14-d_seqno   = count.
*<<<N2287125 - Two records in DME for two tax-deferring accounts
  IF start_dt(4) >= '2015'.
*   1st record
    d_record_14-ira_name        = c_record_hon-ira_nam01.
    d_record_14-ira_biz_no      = c_record_hon-ira_biz01.
    d_record_14-deposit_acc     = c_record_hon-dep_acc01.
    d_record_14-deposit_date    = c_record_hon-dep_dat01.
    d_record_14-deptt           = c_record_hon-dep_amt01.
*   2nd record
    IF c_record_hon-dep_amt02 IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND d_record_14.
      count = 2.
      d_record_14-d_seqno       = count.
      d_record_14-ira_name      = c_record_hon-ira_nam02.
      d_record_14-ira_biz_no    = c_record_hon-ira_biz02.
      d_record_14-deposit_acc   = c_record_hon-dep_acc02.
      d_record_14-deposit_date  = c_record_hon-dep_dat02.
      d_record_14-deptt         = c_record_hon-dep_amt02.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
*>>>N2287125
    d_record_14-ira_name        = c_record_hon-ira_name.
    d_record_14-ira_biz_no      = c_record_hon-ira_biz_no.
    d_record_14-deposit_acc     = c_record_hon-deposit_acc.
    d_record_14-deposit_date    = c_record_hon-deposit_date.
    d_record_14-deptt           = c_record_hon-deptt.
  ENDIF.
  APPEND d_record_14.
endform. " fill_d_record_14
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2014
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       N2108719 [CREATE] - 2014 separation DME
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->FILE_TYPE  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2014 using file_type.
*<<< N2385821
  IF end_dt(4) GE '2016'.
    gv_length = 1110.
  ELSE.
    gv_length = 1090.
  ENDIF.
*>>> N2385821
  PERFORM write_to_record USING 'A' file_type.

  SORT b_record     BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_hon BY bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_record USING 'B' file_type.
    LOOP AT c_record_hon WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                           AND stcd2   = b_record-stcd2
                           AND bukrs   = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_record USING 'C' file_type.
      LOOP AT d_record_14 WHERE pernr = c_record_hon-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_record USING 'D' file_type.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
endform. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_2013
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TO_RECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Create YEA DME record
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* [CREATE] N2108719
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form write_to_record using recordname file_type.
  DATA: lt_dme_file TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dme_line.
  IF file_type = 'LSP'.
    CASE recordname.
      WHEN 'A'.
        PERFORM set_dme_arecord TABLES lt_dme_file.
      WHEN 'B'.
        PERFORM set_dme_brecord TABLES lt_dme_file.
      WHEN 'C'.
        PERFORM set_dme_crecord TABLES lt_dme_file.
      WHEN 'D'.
        PERFORM set_dme_drecord TABLES lt_dme_file.
    ENDCASE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
      EXPORTING
        bufflg   = gv_length
        fbhandle = objhd
      TABLES
        datatab  = lt_dme_file.
  ENDIF.
endform. " WRITE_TO_RECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  add_field
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       -> iv_field   : source field
*       -> iv_len     : length of current field
*       -> iv_kr_field: X: current field is KR language. need to convert
*       -> iv_unpack  : X: need to fill zero on the left
*      <-> cv_dme     : dme file
*      <-> cv_pos     : start postion to write current field to dme
*      <-> cv_tmp     : start postion from last KR field convert
* [CREATE] N2108719
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_field USING iv_field iv_len iv_kr_field iv_unpack
               CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos cv_tmp.

  DATA: lv_len TYPE i.
* move field value to dme file
  IF iv_unpack = gc_true.
    UNPACK iv_field TO cv_dme+cv_pos(iv_len).
  ELSE.
    MOVE   iv_field TO cv_dme+cv_pos(iv_len).
  ENDIF.
* add length of current field to total position
  cv_pos = cv_pos + iv_len.
* when unicode system and current field is KR
  IF gv_charsize > 1 AND iv_kr_field = gc_true.
    lv_len = cv_pos - cv_tmp.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING cv_dme+cv_tmp(lv_len) lv_len.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
    cv_tmp = cv_pos.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  SET_DME_ARECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Create YEA DME for A Record. Common use if A record is not changed
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* [CREATE] N2108719
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_dme_arecord TABLES ct_dme_file.
  DATA:
    lv_len            TYPE i,
    lv_dme            TYPE ty_dme_line.
  lv_len = gv_length - 178.

  MOVE: a_record-r_modif        TO lv_dme+0(1),
        a_record-d_modif_hon    TO lv_dme+1(2),
        a_record-tax_off        TO lv_dme+3(3),
        a_record-submitdt       TO lv_dme+6(8),
        a_record-agency         TO lv_dme+14(1),
        a_record-agent_num      TO lv_dme+15(6),
        a_record-home_tax_id    TO lv_dme+21(20),
        a_record-item8_space    TO lv_dme+41(4),
        a_record-stcd2          TO lv_dme+45(10),
        a_record-comnm          TO lv_dme+55(40),
        a_record-sub_dept       TO lv_dme+95(30),
        a_record-sub_name       TO lv_dme+125(30),
        a_record-ag_telnr       TO lv_dme+155(15),
        a_record-b_rec_num      TO lv_dme+170(5),
        a_record-hangle_code    TO lv_dme+175(3),
        space                   TO lv_dme+178(lv_len).

  IF gv_charsize > 1."KR language system
    CLEAR  out_xstring.
    CLEAR  adj_string.
    CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+0(41)  41.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+41(54) 54.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+95(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+125(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    lv_len = gv_length - 155.
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+155(lv_len) lv_len.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM xstring_to_unistring.
    APPEND  adj_string TO ct_dme_file.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND lv_dme TO ct_dme_file.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " SET_DME_ARECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  SET_DME_BRECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Create YEA DME for B Record. Common use if B record is not changed
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* [CREATE] N2108719
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_dme_brecord TABLES ct_dme_file.
  DATA:
    lv_len            TYPE i,
    lv_zero(14)       TYPE n,
    lv_dme            TYPE ty_dme_line.
  lv_len = gv_length - 217.

  MOVE :  b_record-r_modif         TO  lv_dme+0(1),
          b_record-d_modif_hon     TO  lv_dme+1(2),
          b_record-tax_off         TO  lv_dme+3(3).
  UNPACK: b_record-seqno           TO  lv_dme+6(6).
  MOVE :  b_record-stcd2           TO  lv_dme+12(10),
          b_record-comnm           TO  lv_dme+22(40),
          b_record-repres          TO  lv_dme+62(30),
          b_record-stcd1           TO  lv_dme+92(13),
          b_record-taxpayer        TO  lv_dme+105(1).
  UNPACK  b_record-c_rec_num       TO  lv_dme+106(7).
  MOVE    space                    TO  lv_dme+113(7).
  UNPACK  b_record-tot_separ       TO  lv_dme+120(14).
  IF b_record-inc_tax_13 >= 0.                                 "N1983237
    MOVE '0' to lv_dme+134(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to lv_dme+134(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-inc_tax_13 to lv_dme+135(13).           "N1983237
  UNPACK b_record-tot_tax_def     TO lv_dme+148(13).

  IF b_record-tot_ref_itax >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to lv_dme+161(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to lv_dme+161(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-tot_ref_itax    TO  lv_dme+162(13).

  IF b_record-tot_ref_rtax >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to lv_dme+175(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to lv_dme+175(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-tot_ref_rtax    TO  lv_dme+176(13).

  MOVE lv_zero                     TO lv_dme+189(14).

  IF b_record-tot_ref_total >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to lv_dme+203(1).
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to lv_dme+203(1).
  ENDIF.
  UNPACK b_record-tot_ref_total   TO  lv_dme+204(13).

  MOVE   space                    TO  lv_dme+217(lv_len).

  IF gv_charsize > 1."KR language system
    CLEAR  out_xstring.
    CLEAR  adj_string.
    CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+0(62)  62.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+62(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    lv_len = gv_length - 92.
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   lv_dme+92(lv_len) lv_len.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM xstring_to_unistring.
    APPEND  adj_string TO ct_dme_file.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND lv_dme TO ct_dme_file.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " SET_DME_BRECORD

  ENDIF.
  PERFORM add_field USING lv_indic                       1  "Local Income Tax
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING c_record_hon-ref_rtax_13       11 "Local Income Tax
    space gc_true CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.

  PERFORM add_field USING '0'                            1  "Special tax
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING lv_zero11                      11 "Special tax
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.

  IF c_record_hon-ref_total_13 >= 0.
    MOVE '0' to lv_indic.
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' to lv_indic.
  ENDIF.
  PERFORM add_field USING lv_indic                       1  "Total
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING c_record_hon-ref_total_13      11 "Total
    space gc_true CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.

* final space
  lv_len = gv_length - lv_pos.
  PERFORM add_field USING space                          lv_len
    gc_true space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.            "final convert

  IF gv_charsize > 1.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM xstring_to_unistring.
    APPEND adj_string TO ct_dme_file.
  ELSE.
    APPEND lv_dme TO ct_dme_file.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " SET_DME_CRECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  SET_DME_DRECORD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Create YEA DME for D Record.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* [CREATE] N2108719
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_dme_drecord TABLES ct_dme_file.
  DATA:
    lv_len            TYPE i,"length
    lv_pos            TYPE i,"start position
    lv_tmp            TYPE i,"temp start position
    lv_dme            TYPE ty_dme_line.

  CLEAR out_xstring.
  CLEAR adj_string.
  CLEAR adj_xstring.
  lv_tmp = lv_pos = 0.

* Record class
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-r_modif      1  "Record class
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-d_modif      2  "Data class
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-tax_off      3  "Tax office
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-seqno        6  "Serial number
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
* Obligator of withholding tax
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-stcd2        10 "Business number
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-pre_space    50
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
* Earner
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-regno        13 "Resident no.
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
* Pension Account Deposit Details
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-d_seqno      2  "Sequence no.
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-ira_name     30 "Institution Name
    gc_true space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-ira_biz_no   10 "Tax registration number
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-deposit_acc  20 "Account Number
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-deposit_date 8  "Transfer Date
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING d_record_14-deptt        11 "Transfer Amount
    space space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.

  lv_len = gv_length - lv_pos.
  PERFORM add_field USING space                 lv_len  "final space
    gc_true space CHANGING lv_dme lv_pos lv_tmp.   "convert

  IF gv_charsize > 1.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM xstring_to_unistring.
    APPEND  adj_string TO ct_dme_file.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND lv_dme(gv_length) TO ct_dme_file.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " SET_DME_DRECORD
*N2108719 End

FORM dataset_init USING p_biz_no TYPE char10
                            p_company TYPE text40
                   CHANGING p_created TYPE boole_d.

  DATA: lv_objkn LIKE rptstype-objkn.

  CLEAR: p_created, objin, lv_objkn.
  objin+10(1)   = 'C'.
  objin+11(10)  = p_biz_no.
  objin+26(9)   = 'HKRSEPR0'.

  IF lsp_form = 'X'.                "LSP
    lv_objkn = objkn.
  ELSEIF hon_form = 'X'.            "HON
    lv_objkn = 'KRCSPH'.
  ELSEIF tdf_form = 'X'.            "TDF
    lv_objkn = 'KRCSPD'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'RP_TS_CREATE_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      objkn     = lv_objkn

      empfg     = empfg
      objin     = objin
    IMPORTING
      objhd     = objhd
      tsobj     = tsobj
    EXCEPTIONS
      fb_call_handle          = 1
      fb_error                = 2
      fb_rsts_noconv          = 3
      fb_rsts_other           = 4
      no_object               = 5
      no_permission           = 6
      fb_nr_no_object         = 7
      fb_nr_not_intern        = 8
      fb_nr_not_found         = 9
      fb_object_already_exist = 10
      fb_nr_overflow          = 11
      enq_foreign_lock        = 12
      enq_sys_fail            = 13
      enq_other               = 14.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
  p_created = 'X'.

  CLEAR: temse_file_info.
  temse_file_info-stcd2   = p_biz_no.
  temse_file_info-comnm   = p_company.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  DISPLAY_ALV_LOG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [Log] N2154711- Create
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_alv_log.
  DATA: lv_cated_id       TYPE hrpad_pal_categ_id,
        lv_clbk           TYPE bal_s_clbk.
  DATA: lv_root_node      TYPE p99sb_s_node-node_key.

  DATA: ls_button        TYPE bal_s_push,
        lt_buttons       TYPE hr99b_bal_s_push_tab,
        lv_callback_form TYPE baluef VALUE 'HR_PAL_LOG_USEREXITF'.

  IF object = 'X'.
    IF exists <> 'N' AND
       number > 0    AND
      cl_hr99b_form=>is_framework_active(
        p_molga  = hr99b_form_sel-molga
        p_appl   = hr99b_form_sel-p_appl ) EQ abap_true .
      ls_button-active        = 'X'.
      ls_button-position      = space.
      ls_button-def-icon_id   = icon_pdf.
      ls_button-def-quickinfo = TEXT-L98.
      APPEND ls_button TO lt_buttons.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    lv_cated_id = 'A001'.
    lv_clbk-userexitp = sy-repid.
*   Form name must upper case
    lv_clbk-userexitf = 'DISPLAY_VIEW_LOG'.
    lv_clbk-userexitt = space .

*   Perform Set_FieldCat Changing lt_fcat.
    CALL FUNCTION 'HR_PAL_CREATE_NODE_CATEG'
      EXPORTING
        i_categ_id       = lv_cated_id
        i_structure_name = 'HRPAYKR_S_YEDME_ALV'
        i_clbk           = lv_clbk
      EXCEPTIONS
        program_error = 1.

    CALL FUNCTION 'HR_PAL_NODE_ADD'
      EXPORTING
        i_relatkey        = 'root'
        i_node_txt        = TEXT-L52
        i_expand          = 'X'
        i_label_is_qinfo  = 'X'
        i_categ_id        = lv_cated_id
      IMPORTING
        e_node_key        = lv_root_node.

    CLEAR temse_file_info.
    LOOP AT temse_file_info.
      CALL FUNCTION 'HR_PAL_NODE_ADD_ROW'
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = lv_root_node
          i_row_data = temse_file_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

  obj_pal_log->display(
    p_ext_push_tab = lt_buttons
    p_userexitp    = sy-repid
    p_userexitt    = ' '
    p_flat         = ' '
    p_userexitf    = lv_callback_form ).

ENDFORM. " DISPLAY_ALV_LOG

MODULE SET_PDF OUTPUT.

  DATA: OTF_TAB LIKE  ITCOO OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
        PDF_TABLE LIKE  TLINE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
        PDF_LINE_TAB LIKE  TLINE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
        HTML_TAB TYPE SWXMLCONT OCCURS 0 .
  DATA: PDF_FSIZE TYPE I.
  DATA: G_HTML_CONTAINER TYPE REF TO CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER,
        G_HTML_CONTROL TYPE REF TO CL_GUI_HTML_VIEWER.
  DATA: P_REPID TYPE SY-REPID,
        P_DYNNR TYPE SY-DYNNR,
        URL(255),
        EXTNSION TYPE I.
  DATA: L_CONTENT    TYPE XSTRING,
        LS_PDF       TYPE TLINE.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS <FS_X> TYPE X.

*  OTF_TAB[] = JOB_OUTPUT_INFO-OTFDATA[].
  OTF_TAB[] = GT_OTF[].

*# PDF 미리보기
  CALL FUNCTION 'SSFCOMP_PDF_PREVIEW'
    EXPORTING
      I_OTF                    = OTF_TAB[]
    EXCEPTIONS
      CONVERT_OTF_TO_PDF_ERROR = 1
      CNTL_ERROR               = 2
      OTHERS                   = 3.

*  CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERT_OTF'
*    EXPORTING
*      FORMAT                = 'PDF'
*    IMPORTING
*      BIN_FILESIZE          = PDF_FSIZE
*    TABLES
*      OTF                   = OTF_TAB
*      LINES                 = PDF_TABLE
*    EXCEPTIONS
*      ERR_MAX_LINEWIDTH     = 1
*      ERR_FORMAT            = 2
*      ERR_CONV_NOT_POSSIBLE = 3
*      OTHERS                = 4.
*
**  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
**    CLEAR : LS_PDF, L_CONTENT.
**    LOOP AT PDF_TABLE INTO LS_PDF.
**      ASSIGN LS_PDF TO <FS_X> CASTING.
**      CONCATENATE L_CONTENT <FS_X> INTO L_CONTENT IN BYTE MODE.
**    ENDLOOP.
**
**    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_BINARY'
**      EXPORTING
**        BUFFER     = L_CONTENT
**      TABLES
**        BINARY_TAB = HTML_TAB[].
***    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
***      LS_RESULT-PDF_STRING = L_CONTENT.
***      LS_RESULT-PDF_FSIZE = L_PDF_FSIZE.
***      APPEND LS_RESULT TO T_RESULT.
***    ENDIF.
**  ENDIF.
*
*  PDF_LINE_TAB[] = PDF_TABLE[].
*
*  IF G_HTML_CONTAINER IS INITIAL.
*
*    P_REPID = SY-REPID.
*    P_DYNNR = SY-DYNNR.
*
*    CREATE OBJECT G_HTML_CONTAINER
*      EXPORTING
*        CONTAINER_NAME = 'HTML_CONTAINER'.
*
*    CREATE OBJECT G_HTML_CONTROL
*      EXPORTING
*        PARENT = G_HTML_CONTAINER.
*
*  ENDIF.
*
*  CALL METHOD G_HTML_CONTROL->LOAD_DATA
*    EXPORTING
**     SIZE         = PDF_FSIZE
*      TYPE         = 'APPLICATION'
*      SUBTYPE      = 'PDF'
*    IMPORTING
*      ASSIGNED_URL = URL
*    CHANGING
**     DATA_TABLE   = HTML_TAB[].  "PDF_LINE_TAB[].
*      DATA_TABLE   = PDF_LINE_TAB[].
*
** 자동 flush
*  CALL METHOD CL_GUI_CFW=>FLUSH.
*
*  CALL METHOD G_HTML_CONTROL->SHOW_DATA
*    EXPORTING
*      URL      = URL
*      IN_PLACE = 'X'     "SHOWN IN R/3 GUI
*    EXCEPTIONS
*      OTHERS   = 0.

ENDMODULE. " SET_PDF OUTPUT

*=[ Form ]=============================================================*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  PBO_HTML_CONTROL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM PBO_HTML_CONTROL .

*  SET PF-STATUS 'HTML'.
  SET PF-STATUS 'PF_0100'.
  SET TITLEBAR  'HTML'.

* container
  IF PDF_MY_CONTAINER IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT PDF_MY_CONTAINER
      EXPORTING
        CONTAINER_NAME = 'HTML'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
      RAISE CNTL_ERROR.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* html control
  IF PDF_HTML_CONTROL IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT PDF_HTML_CONTROL
      EXPORTING
        PARENT = PDF_MY_CONTAINER
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
      RAISE CNTL_ERROR.
    ENDIF.

* alignment
    PDF_ALIGNMENT = PDF_HTML_CONTROL->ALIGN_AT_LEFT  +
                    PDF_HTML_CONTROL->ALIGN_AT_RIGHT +
                    PDF_HTML_CONTROL->ALIGN_AT_TOP   +
                    PDF_HTML_CONTROL->ALIGN_AT_BOTTOM.
    CALL METHOD PDF_HTML_CONTROL->SET_ALIGNMENT
      EXPORTING
        ALIGNMENT = PDF_ALIGNMENT
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.
    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
      RAISE CNTL_ERROR.
    ENDIF.
    PERFORM PDF_SHOW.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM. " PBO_HTML_CONTROL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  PDF_SHOW
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM PDF_SHOW .

  TYPES: LT_PDF_TABLE(1000) TYPE X.
  DATA:  L_URL(80)        TYPE C,
         L_PDF_DATA       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF LT_PDF_TABLE,
         L_PDF_LINE       TYPE LT_PDF_TABLE,
         L_OFFSET         TYPE I,
         L_LEN            TYPE I.

  L_LEN = XSTRLEN( PDF_DATA ).
  WHILE L_LEN >= 1000.
    L_PDF_LINE = PDF_DATA+L_OFFSET(1000).
    APPEND L_PDF_LINE TO L_PDF_DATA.
    ADD 1000 TO L_OFFSET.
    SUBTRACT 1000 FROM L_LEN.
  ENDWHILE.
  IF L_LEN > 0.
    L_PDF_LINE = PDF_DATA+L_OFFSET(L_LEN).
    APPEND L_PDF_LINE TO L_PDF_DATA.
  ENDIF.
  CALL METHOD PDF_HTML_CONTROL->LOAD_DATA
    EXPORTING
      URL          = 'smart.pdf'
      SIZE         = PDF_SIZE
      TYPE         = 'application'
      SUBTYPE      = 'pdf'
    IMPORTING
      ASSIGNED_URL = L_URL
    CHANGING
      DATA_TABLE   = L_PDF_DATA
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS       = 1.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    RAISE CNTL_ERROR.
  ENDIF.

* show data
  CALL METHOD PDF_HTML_CONTROL->SHOW_DATA
    EXPORTING
      URL    = L_URL
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS = 1.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    RAISE CNTL_ERROR.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM. " PDF_SHOW
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  PAI_HTML_CONTROL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM PAI_HTML_CONTROL .

  CASE FCODE.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
      IF NOT PDF_HTML_CONTROL IS INITIAL.

      ENDIF.
